{{Quote|What the&mdash;|CT-327, shortly before being killed by BX-series droid commandos|<ref name="Rookies" />}}
'''CT-327''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served as a [[Deck officer/Legends|deck]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], CT-327 and a group of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were stationed in a [[Rishi Station/Legends|listening post]] on the [[Rishi moon]], due to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] need to observe [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] activity in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. CT-327 was given the task of guarding the base exterior, while the rest of the clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] stayed within the listening post. During one of his patrols, CT-327 noticed a [[Meteor shower/Legends|meteor shower]]. Unbeknownst to him, Confederate [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|droid commandos]], on board a [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ship]], were hiding in the [[Asteroid/Legends|meteor]] shower. CT-327 was instantly [[Death/Legends|killed]] when one of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] struck him with a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|CT-327, report in. Sentry, do you copy?|After the meteor shower, O'Niner contacted CT-327, but received no response from the deck officer|<ref name="Rookies" />}}
CT-327 was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Deck officer/Legends|deck]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] born on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="Rookies" /> Like all [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], he was a clone of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="db" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], CT-327 and a group of clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] were stationed in a remote [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Rishi Station/Legends|listening post]] located on the [[Rishi moon|moon]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], due to the Republic's need to watch for [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] activity in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. While a number of the clone troopers were stationed inside the listening post, CT-327 was given the task of patrolling outside the base.<ref name="Rookies" />

[[File:CT-327_electrocuted.png|thumb|left|200px|CT-327 is electrocuted by commando droids.]]
After spotting an approaching [[Meteor shower/Legends|meteor shower]], the clone utilized his [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|binocular visor]] to get a glimpse of the ongoing event. However, unbeknownst to CT-327, Confederate [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|droid commandos]], inside a [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ship]], were hiding in the meteor shower. A [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] soon appeared in front of CT-327, catching him off-guard. The clone was attacked from behind by the [[Sparky/Legends|captain]] of the commando droids, who used a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]] to strike CT-327, resulting in his [[Death/Legends|death]]. CT-327's failure to report in concerned [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[O'Niner/Legends|O'Niner]] inside the base.<ref name="Rookies" /> Troopers [[Nub/Legends|Nub]] and [[Droidbait/Legends|Droidbait]] were sent by the [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] to investigate 327's disappearance,<ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}}</ref> but were both killed by the commando droids, along with O'Niner. The four surviving [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]] and [[Cutup/Legends|Cutup]] used the ventilation shaft to escape, while the commando droids captured the Republic base.<ref name="Rookies" />

After [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] landed their [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]], Cody remarked he did not like that the deck officer was not in sight. However, Rex quickly determined the base was [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|ambushed]], after the surviving clones sent a [[Droid attack flare/Legends|droid attack flare]]. Once Rex and Cody found the three surviving [[Shiny/Legends|shinies]], the five clones worked together to retake the base and drive the Separatists off Rishi. The Rishi Base's destruction alerted the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]], who drove [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous']] forces away from the Rishi moon.<ref name="Rookies" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This is the deck officer checking in. Nothing going on&hellip;as usual.|CT-327 checks in from his post|<ref name="Rookies" />}}
[[File:Ct-327-Rishi-Station.png|thumb|right|250px|CT-327 patrolling the Rishi Base.]]
As a clone of Fett,<ref name="Rookies" /> CT-327 stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="db" /> and [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> During his patrols on the Rishi [[Moon/Legends|moon]], CT-327 reported the status of his location to the clone troopers inside the base and expressed that nothing occurred at the listening post. When a meteor shower began, CT-327 left his post to watch the shower. Not realizing there were commando droids inside a boarding ship hidden in the meteor shower, the clone had little time to react when the commando droids suddenly attacked and killed him.<ref name="Rookies" />

==Equipment==
The clone trooper wore white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone armor]] and his [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] featured a red-colored binocular visor.<ref name="Rookies" />

==Behind the scenes==
CT-327 first appeared in "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]," the fifth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, aired on [[October 24]], [[2008]]. He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices all clone troopers throughout the series. CT-327's designation number is another appearance of the digits "327," a recurring number in Lucas' productions.<ref name="EpGuide" />
